title_zh: 场景 14 城市议题路由台桌面推演说明
title_en: Scenario 14 Civic Issue Router Tabletop Guide
purpose_zh: 用零依赖、完全离线、确定性的规则执行器证明 PASS / HOLD / RETIRED 判据可以被逐条复演。
purpose_en: Use a zero-dependency, fully offline, deterministic rule runner to rehearse PASS / HOLD / RETIRED criteria item by item.

files.contract.json: 规则、RACI、红牌、独立申诉、数据边界和证据契约
files.fixtures.positive.json: 一条完整 PASS 合成样例
files.fixtures.negative.json: 五条 HOLD 与一条 RETIRED 合成样例及变异说明
files.run_tabletop.js: Node.js 内置模块执行器；默认核对提交内回执
files.receipts.json: 确定性公开回执；不含个人数据或现场结果

generation_note_zh: 默认命令不写文件；仅显式 --write-receipts 会机械刷新确定性回执。提交前再次运行默认命令会逐字核对 committed receipts。
generation_note_en: The default command writes no files; only explicit --write-receipts mechanically refreshes deterministic receipts. Run the default command again before submission to compare the committed receipts byte-for-byte.
decision_note_zh: PASS 只表示合成材料可提交真实人审；HOLD 表示阻断且需补证据；RETIRED 表示合成 Branch 已关闭归档。三者都不是现场授权。
decision_note_en: PASS only makes the synthetic package eligible for real human review; HOLD blocks it pending evidence; RETIRED closes and archives the synthetic Branch. None is a field authorisation.
